column2: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE REPEAL OF THE REGIONAL
INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT LEVY ACT, NO. 51 OF 2006

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Regional Infrastructure

column1: Act, No. 51 of 2006 is hereby deemed to be repealed with

column2: (2) The provisions of this Act shall, notwithstanding such

column1: repeal, in respect of the matters set out in subsection (3), be
in operation for a period of one year from the date of the
coming into operation of this Act.

column2: (3)  Notwithstanding  the  repeal  of  the  Regional

column1: Infrastructure Development Levy Act, No. 51 of 2006 with
effect from  January 1, 2011, the Director-General of Customs
is hereby empowered to recover all sums due under section
2 of the repealed Act, as Regional Infrastructure Development
Levy  with  effect  from  January  1,  2011,  to  the  day
immediately  preceding  the  day  on  which  the  period  of
operation  of  one  year  specified  in  subsection  (2)  expires,
and  transmit  all  sums  so  recovered  by  him  as  Regional
Infrastructure Development Levy, to the Consolidated Fund
in terms of section 5 of the repealed Act.

column2: In the event of an inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text to prevail.
